dog.description_text:
Stanwyck is a culinary queen!

Stanwyck is a 3-year-old black cat who knows exactly what gets her attention: the sound of a can of food opening! She's usually among the first to arrive at mealtime and is happy to accept some gentle pets while enjoying her favorite food. When dinner is over, she's more of an observer who likes to find a comfortable spot and watch the activity around her. She's a relaxed, easygoing girl who enjoys taking in the world at her own pace.

Stanwyck is also quite social with other cats and enjoys spending time with her feline companions. When it comes to toys, she's a bit more of a window shopper than an eager player, preferring to explore her options before deciding what catches her interest. Her new family will have the fun of getting to know her preferences and discovering what brings out her playful side.

Stanwyck would love to meet you, especially if you have treats to offer! To learn more about Stanwyck, click the “Adopt Me” button.

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
